changes.new_text: The optical warning indication shall be activated when the vehicle master control switch is in the "on" (run) position (bulb check).
changes.reason: Paragraph 5.1.6.2 of UN R64 was amended in version 3.2.0: 'optical' was added; 'signal' became 'indication'; 'ignition (start)' became 'vehicle master control'.

changes.new_text: A Run Flat System warning signal described in paragraph 5.1.6.1. shall be indicated at the latest when one tyre is detected to be in the flat tyre running mode .
changes.reason: Paragraph 5.1.6.3 of UN R64 was amended in version 3.2.0: 'Run Flat System' was added; 'signal described in paragraph 5.1.6.1.' was added; 'to the driver by the operation of the warning signal referred to in paragraph 5.1.6.1.' was removed; 'mode.' became 'mode .'.

changes.new_text: If the warning signal described in paragraph 5.1.6.1. is used to indicate both a tyre in the run-flat mode and a malfunction in the run-flat warning system, the following shall apply: with the vehicle master control switch in the "on" (run) position the warning signal shall flash to indicate a system failure.
changes.reason: Paragraph 5.1.6.4 of UN R64 was amended in version 3.2.0: 'Run-Flat Warning System,' became 'run-flat warning system,'; 'ignition (start)' became 'vehicle master control'.

changes.new_text: After a short period of time the warning signal shall remain continuously illuminated as long as the failure exists and the vehicle master control switch is in the "on" (run) position.
changes.reason: Paragraph 5.1.6.4 of UN R64 was amended in version 3.2.0: 'ignition (start)' became 'vehicle master control'.

changes.new_text: The flashing and illumination sequence shall be repeated each time the vehicle master control switch is in the "on" (run) position until the failure has been corrected.
changes.reason: Paragraph 5.1.6.4 of UN R64 was amended in version 3.2.0: 'ignition (start)' became 'vehicle master control'.

changes.new_text: The braking performance shall correspond to the test procedure given in UN Regulation No. 13 or 13-H for categories M1 and N1 vehicles for the Type O cold test with the engine disconnected, and is based on the stopping distance and the mean fully developed deceleration.

changes.new_text: The vehicle shall be brought to a halt and the vehicle master control switch switched off.
